greet.speaker: Lorekeeper Spirit
greet.text: A translucent figure hovers over an open ledger, ink dripping upward from its pages. "Answer my riddle, and the stacks beyond will open to you."
greet.text_zh: 一個半透明的身影懸浮在攤開的帳冊上方，墨水正向上滴落。「答對我的謎語，後面的書庫就會為你開啟。」

choices.text_zh: 你已經知道我的答案了。

riddle.speaker: Lorekeeper Spirit
riddle.text: "The more you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?"
riddle.text_zh: 「拿得越多，留下的也越多。我是什麼？」

wrong.speaker: Lorekeeper Spirit
wrong.text: The ledger's pages riffle in disappointment. "Not quite. Think again, traveler."
wrong.text_zh: 帳冊的書頁失望地翻動著。「不太對。再想想吧，旅人。」

correct.speaker: Lorekeeper Spirit
correct.text: "Footsteps — yes. Every one you take is both taken and left." The air past the shelves grows lighter. The way is open.
correct.text_zh: 「腳印——沒錯。每一步既是帶走，也是留下。」書架後方的空氣變得輕盈了些。通道開啟了。

already_solved.speaker: Lorekeeper Spirit
already_solved.text: "Footsteps, footsteps... a fine answer. Go on, the stacks are yours to wander."
already_solved.text_zh: 「腳印、腳印……好答案。去吧，書庫任你遨遊。」
